text.tspan: Share of respondents agreeing with the statement "Most people can be trusted". The Gini coefficient measures
inequality on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher inequality.
Share agreeing "Most people can be trusted"

tspan.tspan: Integrated Values Surveys (2024); World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
For each country, trust data is shown for the latest survey wave in the period 2009-2022. Depending on the country and year, inequality

text.tspan: data relates to income measured after taxes and benefits, or to consumption, per capita. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from
the closest year between 2009 and 2025 is shown instead.
